_comment: Cursor config for the GeoLens read-only MCP server. Save as .cursor/mcp.json in your project (or ~/.cursor/mcp.json to apply everywhere) and restart Cursor. As written it points at the public demo instance and needs no credentials. For your own instance, change GEOLENS_INSTANCE and add "GEOLENS_API_KEY": "your-api-key" to the env block.
